subject: Mutual action plan: Finory security review & SOC 2 evidence timeline
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@finory.com>, Rajesh Kaur <rajesh.kaur@finory.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Post-call recap + draft MAP: security review & SOC 2 evidence

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on timing and scope. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (redwood-map-v1.xlsx) focused on the security review / SOC 2 package milestone. High level summary and asks below. Please review and reply with any changes by EOD Monday so we can lock dates into the MAP.

Key milestone (security review / SOC 2 package):
- Objective: Finory to provide completed SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence registry so Redwood can validate controls and prepare any additional guidance.
- Target MAP close for contract signature: 2027-07-15 (internal target, flexible with mutual agreement).

Draft milestones and owners (summary):
1) SOC 2 questionnaire completed (Finory Security) — due 2027-06-18
2) Evidence export / evidence registry (Finory IT) — due 2027-06-25
3) Redwood evidence review & gap memo (Redwood Security) — due 2027-07-01
4) Final evidence package delivery (Finory) — due 2027-07-07
5) Sign-off & contract execution (both) — target 2027-07-15

Dependencies called out: procurement PO/contract approval, temporary S3 access for Finory evidence uploads (or shared Drive), and confirmation of any third-party reports Finory will share (e.g., vendor audits).

Immediate asks:
- Lydia / Rajesh: confirm the owners above or suggest alternates and confirm whether the evidence due dates (6/25 for registry) are achievable.
- Procurement: if procurement needs to be looped earlier for the final 7/15 signature, let us know the internal timeline.

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (draft MAP workbook)

Thanks — I’ll take this draft into our internal alignment once we have your comments.

--
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134


From: Lydia Park <lydia@finory.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kaur <rajesh.kaur@finory.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP: security review & SOC 2 evidence

Thanks Alex — helpful. A few clarifications from our side after internal review: 

1) Questionnaire: we’ll take point on completing the SOC 2 questionnaire but need one week (propose 2027-06-22) — several controls need vendor confirmation.
2) Evidence: our IT team will populate the evidence registry but we need the evidence template you referenced. Can you attach the registry CSV so we can start?
3) KMS / keying: our security lead Rajesh flagged that any evidence referencing KMS keys must include key IDs and policy docs — can Redwood confirm if that is required for your reviewers?

Potential blockers:
- Procurement legal has a review backlog; their earliest window for signature review is 2027-07-08, so the 7/15 signature target might be tight unless we run parallel redlines.
- We will need a temporary S3 bucket or secure upload mechanism (SFTP) for larger evidence exports. Procurement prefers a vendor-hosted SharePoint link but IT can consume S3 if provided.

I’m attaching our controls summary (Finory_existing_controls_summary.pdf) to help accelerate the questionnaire. We’ll confirm owners (security vs. IT) by end of day Monday.

Best,
Lydia
CFO, Finory
lydia@finory.com


From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@finory.com>, Rajesh Kaur <rajesh.kaur@finory.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Finory Procurement <procurement@finory.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP: security review & SOC 2 evidence

Appreciate the quick review, Lydia — useful flags. Updated plan below (I’ve also attached the SOC2 questionnaire template and a minimal evidence registry CSV to accelerate work): Finory_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx, evidence_registry_template.csv.

Updated milestone dates (proposal):
- SOC 2 questionnaire completed (Finory Security) — due 2027-06-22 (updated per Lydia)
- Evidence registry populated (Finory IT) — due 2027-06-29 (move out 4 days to allow IT ingest)
- Redwood review & gap memo (Redwood Security: Marissa) — due 2027-07-05
- Evidence remediation or supplemental ask window — 2027-07-06 to 2027-07-12
- Final evidence package ready for auditor handoff — due 2027-07-13
- Contract sign-off (both parties) — target 2027-07-20 (moving to allow procurement runway)

Responses to Rajesh’s KMS question: yes, include key IDs and any KMS policy attachments where applicable. Our reviewers will accept a short manifest entry per key (key ID, region, usage, attached policy excerpt). If you prefer, Redwood Security can provide an example key manifest entry — ping Marissa and we’ll share a template.

Temporary upload options: we can stand up a short-lived S3 bucket and provide IAM bindings for Finory IT to upload evidence. Our security ops will generate a pre-signed-upload workflow if SharePoint is preferred by procurement; please confirm.

Next steps / asks (action items):
- Finory: confirm owners and accept updated milestone dates by EOD Mon 2027-06-07.
- Procurement (Finory): confirm whether SharePoint or S3 upload will be acceptable for evidence transfer.
- Redwood (Marissa): prepping example KMS manifest and sample evidence checklist (Marissa to attach during review).

I’ll update the MAP workbook with these dates and circulate an updated tab after we hear back.

Attachments: Finory_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx, evidence_registry_template.csv

Thanks — Alex
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0000
Subject: Internal: Finory MAP — security milestone notes

Quick internal note after the thread above:
- I will draft the KMS manifest example and the short evidence checklist today (will attach to the MAP workbook).
- Engineering (Hannah) — can you confirm by EOD Wed if we can provision a short-lived S3 bucket and a pre-signed upload flow? If procurement prefers SharePoint we can provide that alternative, but engineering lead time differs.
- Risk: procurement window pushes sign-off; if legal needs redlines earlier we should be prepared to accept a rolling signature (one-off) to avoid blocking the June/July window.

I’ll update the hubspot record and the MAP workbook once we have the confirmed owners from Finory.

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Security Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
